To successfully apply for a qualification, promotion, or anything from the [61^st^ CNU section], it is **MANDATORY** to adhere to the instructions and recommendations provided by the section.
All the necessary information  are avalaible on the [61^st^ CNU section] website.

:::{.callout-important}
- **All your information must be verifiable**, without the need for reviewers to carry out complicated research by themselves.
- When presenting information, it is important to provide context and explain the relevance of the information. 
  Simply listing information without explanation is meaningless.
  Therefore, it is recommended to add a few additional words to clarify what is being done or what it is related to.
:::

[61^st^ CNU section]: <https://conseil-national-des-universites.fr/cnu/#/entite/entiteName/CNU/idChild/33/idNode/4243-4270> "61^st^ section CNU"

# About your publications

## For journals

For each journal, you need to specify whether it is JCR-indexed or not.
To check if a journal is JCR-indexed, you have to check if it can be found on [{{< ai clarivate title='Explore JCR-indexed' >}} Clarivate](https://mjl.clarivate.com/home).\
Moreover, feel free to give some indicators (metrics) for each journal, in particular its **quartile** (i.e. Q1, Q2...).
To find a journal quartile you must use [Scimagojr](https://www.scimagojr.com/).
Notice that the impact factor alone is meaningless because it can be artificially inflated.
If you want to give it, as different databases can be used, you should prefer the one from the <abbrv title="Web of Science">WoS</abbrv> database (available from [{{< ai clarivate title='Explore JCR-indexed' >}} Clarivate](https://clarivate.com/)).

On the other hand, it is important to be cautious of the issues related to certain journals.
The credibility of some articles, journals, and publishers may be questionable.
It may be helpful to refer to <https://predatoryreports.org>, even if this source is not entirely reliable.

## For conferences

Reviewers will only consider conference articles from young researchers who meet the minimum standards of a good peer-reviewed conference.
To determine a conference's ranking, consult  <http://www.conferenceranks.com/> or <https://www.resurchify.com/>.
